title: Puppet Master Jujutsu command integration contracts
description: Jujutsu-owned discriminated command request, result, error, availability, disabled-reason, exact target, currentness, interop-gate, confirmation, affected-identity, Backup operation/object closure, and isolated restore-verification contracts. Neutral RepositoryContext, Jujutsu revision, writer lease, credential lease, permission, FileSafe, BackupManifest/RestoreRun, Forge/Automation bindings, persistence, events, and runtime implementation retain their canonical owners.

currentness_fence_uninitialized_destinat.description: The same Host/Environment/adapter/catalog fence, for the clone phase in which native initialization has not created the destination repository yet. Native snapshot and operation identity do not exist in that phase and are null rather than fabricated.

native_state_phase.description: Absent means the ordinary initialized-repository phase. destination_not_initialized is admitted only for cmd.jujutsu.git.clone, before native initialization creates the destination repository.

x-puppet-master-assertions: clone return_context is echoed byte-for-byte by the terminal command_result
caller close or navigation does not cancel dispatched Jujutsu work

native_state_phase.description: Absent means the ordinary initialized-repository phase. destination_not_initialized is admitted only for cmd.jujutsu.git.clone, where no native before-state existed at the destination.

x-puppet-master-assertions: terminal clone result returns the initiating return_context exactly
cancelled clone reports cleanup state and creates no registered Project
clone currentness equals the admitted request fence

backup_jj_closure_record.title: BackupJujutsuClosureRecord
x-puppet-master-assertions: operation heads views commits trees conflicts and retained non-current objects are content coverage; op-log text or remote reachability alone is insufficient
capture_barrier_ref and gc_fence_ref are owner evidence and do not authorize a second mutation authority
dirty files remain distinct from the latest JJ snapshot and no capture step may manufacture a hidden operation
expected_event_types remains empty until Event Authority separately admits a producer and payload

backup_jj_restore_verification_receipt.title: BackupJujutsuRestoreVerificationReceipt
x-puppet-master-assertions: verification uses a disposable restored copy and does not mutate the active original repository
read verification uses an ignore-working-copy mode where required and does not manufacture a JJ snapshot
colocated activation requires one JJ writer and cannot use implicit import export or fallback Git mutation
restored credential and remote references remain pending named-owner validation; RepositoryForgeBinding and AutomationBinding remain separate
expected_event_types remains empty until Event Authority separately admits a producer and payload

x-backup-jj-claim-boundary.owner_split: Jujutsu owns operation object workspace colocation and conflict truth; Backup owns manifest bytes RestoreRun staging activation rollback and readiness
x-backup-jj-claim-boundary.command_effect: the exact 31-command inventory is unchanged; no JJ-private Backup command or handler is admitted and existing routes retain handler_unavailable until independently proven
x-backup-jj-claim-boundary.event_effect: expected_event_types=[]; receipt-only until Event Authority admits an exact producer payload retention redaction and consumer transaction
x-backup-jj-claim-boundary.protected_data: restored credentials hooks helpers unsafe includes extraHeaders URL user-info filters and private material remain inactive excluded or owner-validation pending
